extension.name: in.mohd.processors.print_processor.MyProcessor
extension.description: Lists the files found in a configured directory, prints every file name to the NiFi log and transfers the result to the 'success' relationship so that the next processor in the flow can consume it. Either one FlowFile per file is created (the FlowFile content is the file name and its attributes describe the file) or a single FlowFile that contains the whole listing, one file name per line.

property.name: Input Directory
property.description: The directory whose file names should be listed, for example C:\data\inbox

property.name: Recurse Subdirectories
property.description: When true the subdirectories of the input directory are listed as well

property.name: File Filter
property.description: A regular expression that a file name has to match in order to be listed, for example .*\.csv

property.name: Output Mode
property.description: Determines how the file listing is transferred to the 'success' relationship

allowableValue.description: Create one FlowFile for every listed file. The FlowFile content is the file name and the filename, path, absolute.path, file.size and file.lastModified attributes describe the file.
Create a single FlowFile whose content is the complete list of file names, one file name per line.

relationship.name: success
relationship.description: FlowFiles that carry the listed file name(s) to the next processor in the flow

writesAttribute.name: filename
writesAttribute.description: The name of the listed file (one-FlowFile-per-file mode only)

writesAttribute.name: path
writesAttribute.description: The listed file's directory relative to the configured input directory, with a trailing separator

writesAttribute.name: absolute.path
writesAttribute.description: The listed file's absolute directory, with a trailing separator

writesAttribute.name: file.size
writesAttribute.description: The size of the listed file in bytes

writesAttribute.name: file.lastModified
writesAttribute.description: The last modified time of the listed file in ISO-8601 format

writesAttribute.name: file.count
writesAttribute.description: The number of files that were listed by this invocation

writesAttribute.name: input.directory
writesAttribute.description: The absolute path of the directory that was listed
